input.answer: I didn't decide anything. It's a long dark table full of numbers and company names I've never heard of, nothing about deposits or how safe it is, so I'll ask you or the bank before I put a shekel into a "קופת גמל להשקעה".

stuck.why: The page says it's grouped by 'חברה', but the first block of rows has no company name I could see. So I don't know whose 'מניות סחיר' at 0.54% that is.
Some rows have numbers and others just say 'פחות מ־3 שנים'. I didn't know if that means it's new, or bad, or what.
I couldn't read the yellow and green circles. One row even says 'מניות 101%', and I don't see how anything can be more than everything.

stuck.where: The first screen's choice buttons ('עוקב מדד s&p 500', 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש', 'הלכה')
stuck.why: I didn't know which button would show me something safe like a deposit. I left it on 'הכל' and the list never ended.
